cd /workspace/project && echo "=== hotline.dev ==="; curl -s --max-time 25 -A "Mozilla/5.0" "https://computer.hotline.dev/" | python3 -c "
import sys,re,html
s=sys.stdin.read(); s=re.sub(r'<script.*?</script>','',s,flags=re.S); s=re.sub(r'<style.*?</style>','',s,flags=re.S)
t=html.unescape(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ',s)); t=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',t); print(t[:900])
"; echo; echo "=== bootstrapped-credits ==="; curl -s --max-time 25 "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aidenixai/bootstrapped-credits/main/README.md" | head -50
